review.ownership: Own corporate page and six native project scenes reviewed. One own-page community image plus five native branded brochure resources selected. Decorative colour fields, generic family/model photography and duplicate resource variants excluded. Whole community aerial is owned card and hero. Brochure resources remain honestly identified as broker-hosted branded originals.
review.drawings: All16-page brochure,21-page expanded edition,22-page portal edition and three-page compact plan indexes reviewed. Three expanded whole townhouse drawings, three type keys, master plan, regional map and three compact area sheets inspected complete. Six full numeric panels independently reviewed. Whole source pages, notices, logos and both floors retained.
review.areas: Expanded type keys15/17/19 print BUA2721/2722/3500 and plots2109/2900/3427. Compact pages2/1/3 print same BUA but plots2108/2899/3427. One-square-foot plot differences remain explicit. Type key totals cover both drawn floors once. No room dimensions added to invent BUA.
review.location: Original brochure6 and expanded5 give matching named regional map and eight journey labels. First two walking1/3, next two driving3/5, remaining8/10/30/55 mode unspecified. Source-era RAK Central and proposed Wynn scope retained. Individual entrance coordinates unavailable.
